title: Name the player before the last clue | FAN LIFE Blind Cow
description:
One player. Five clues. How many do you need? Blind Cow on FAN LIFE, shown with Panathinaikos: Blind Cow is a guessing game. One player from your club's history, hidden behind his clues. The clues come one at a time: where he's from, where he played, a season, a shirt number. Every clue is sourced. The fewer clues you need, the better your time. A wrong guess costs you seconds. Play it solo, or send a friend the same player and race them, clue for clue.

▶ Play it: https://fanlife.dubelteam.com/clubs/panathinaikos/blind-cow

Narration is synthetic. #FANLIFE #FootballGames #FootballFans
